title: Vanilla Ultra Deluxe
description: You're getting vanilla, the finest vanilla.
body:
# Vanilla Ultra Deluxe
This modpack aims to include the best mods and resource packs I could find while still remaining compatible with vanilla servers. It includes all your favorite client-side mods, and if it doesn't, add it yourself!

### Notable features
- **Enchanted books** and **potions** all have their **own texture** to **distinguish** them easily. 
![An assortment of enchanted books and potions to showcase the texture difference between them](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bfacea6f1f4a8d283bf89610a462f2d11254851f.png)

_Credit to **[Even Better Enchants](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/even-better-enchants)** by **mythitorium** and **[Xali's Potions](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/xalis-potions)** by **xalixilax**_
- **Stacking** to nearby **chests** (Like a built in, quicker, copper golem)
![An image that shows the buttons to stack your items to nearby chests containing those items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b6e62021c22e3b5a934e37ebca4fc041291e72e.png)

_Credit to **[ Stack to Nearby Chests](https://modrinth.com/mod/stack-to-nearby-chests)** by **Xiaocihua**_
 
- Hold **R** to **swap between tools** by **scrolling** (Like an inventory managing update!)
- ![A display of different tools to select by scrolling](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e747d037e207ec3e14148d15a18ab46739a0d455_0.webp)

_Credit to **[ItemSwapper](https://modrinth.com/mod/itemswapper)** by **tr7zw**_

- **Sorting inventories** (Your own and your storage)

- **Automatic elytra swapping** (Just press space while falling and your elytra will equip itself)

Some more useful keybinds are:
- **C** to **Zoom** (Like a spyglass without a spyglass)
- **F4** to **Freecam** (No noclipping, solely for looking at your builds!)
- **F9** for **Light Overlay** (See where mobs can spawn)
- **B** to **mute specific sounds**
- **X** to **inspect** your **tools** in first person (it makes them do a little spin!)

### Shaders
This modpack uses Iris with the beautiful Complementary Shaders. To make this even better we have added the Euphoria Patches addon, creating an absolutely beautiful world to explore and live in. To make the world feel bigger the mod Distant Horizons is also installed, which allows you to see much farther without being limited by the normal render distance.

### Optimization
From Sodium to Entity Culling to dynamic FPS, this modpack utilizes all the best optimization mods I could find to make your experience as smooth as possible.

### Cosmetic additions
This modpack features tons of cosmetic mods. These mods include sounds, animations, particles and HUD elements. A little bit of everything! Some included are:
- **[AmbientSounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds)**; Birds chirping, waves crashing
- **[Better GUI](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-vanilla-gui)**; Every crafting station gets its own UI
- **[Chat Animation [Smooth Chat]](https://modrinth.com/mod/chatanimation)**; Make chat feel smoother
- **[Chat Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/chat-heads)**; See who is chatting
- **[Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity)**; Connect glass and more
- **[Effectual](https://modrinth.com/mod/effectual)**; Lots of particles where they should be
- **[Enchantment Outlines](https://modrinth.com/mod/glowing-glints)**; Enchanted gear looks awesome (And the mace 3d!)
- **[Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations)**; A super well made overhaul of all mobs' animations
- **[Hold My Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/hold-my-items)**; Make first person feel alive
- **[Icons](https://modrinth.com/mod/icons)**; Make everything feel more lively
- **[Particle Effects](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-effects)**; Every potion effect gets its own style
- **[Particular ✨ Reforged](https://modrinth.com/mod/particular-reforged)**; Splashes, waterfalls and fireflies
- **[Smooth Swapping](https://modrinth.com/mod/smooth-swapping)**; A nicer item moving animation on the eyes
- **[Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered)**; Adds more realism to the sounds around you
- **[Stylish Effects](https://modrinth.com/mod/stylish-effects)**; See how long that levitation will last
- **[Tender Dragon](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/tender-dragon)**; A visual revamp for the Ender Dragon
- **[Theone's Eating Animation Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/theones-eating-animation-pack)**; Food gets actually eaten
- **[Visual: Armor Trims](https://modrinth.com/mod/visual-armor-trims)**; See what trims are on your armor
- **[Wakes](https://modrinth.com/mod/wakes)**; Have the water move around you
- **[Windy](https://modrinth.com/mod/windy)**; Some neat unobtrusive wind particles

### Gameplay additions
As said in the "Notable features" section, this modpack uses **[ Stack to Nearby Chests](https://modrinth.com/mod/stack-to-nearby-chests)**. Furthermore we use **[Nemo's Inventory Sorting](https://modrinth.com/mod/nemos-inventory-sorting)** for easy and quick sorting and **[ClickThrough Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/clickthrough+)** so that a sign on a chest won't be an annoyance for once.

Other notable gameplay additions are:
- **[AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin)**; Shows food value of edible items
- **[Armor Hud](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-hud)**; Shows you your armor durability in your hotbar
- **[Better Mount HUD](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-mount-hud)**; Shows more of your stats while riding a mount
- **[Controlling](https://modrinth.com/mod/controlling)**; Search your keybinds
- **[Cut Through](https://modrinth.com/mod/cut-through)**; Swing weapons through grass
- **[Durability Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/durability-tooltip)**; See your durability without advanced tooltips
- **[ItemSwapper](https://modrinth.com/mod/itemswapper)**; Swap items easily
- **[Jade 🔍](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade)**; Know what you are looking at
- **[JJElytraSwap](https://modrinth.com/mod/jjelytraswap)**; Use your elytra whenever you please
- **[Light Overlay](https://modrinth.com/mod/lightoverlay)**; Light up your base against mobs
- **[Locator Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/locator-heads)**; See who actually are those colored dots
- **[Overflowing Bars](https://modrinth.com/mod/overflowing-bars)**; More armor info on hud
- **[Peek](https://modrinth.com/mod/peek)**; Look into shulker boxes (and more)
- **[Pick Up Notifier](https://modrinth.com/mod/pick-up-notifier)**; See what you are picking up, and how much
- **[Projectile Trajectory Preview](https://modrinth.com/mod/ptp)**; Never miss a pearl again
- **[Replanter Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/replanter-plus)**; Make farming less of a hassle
- **[Sounds Be Gone!](https://modrinth.com/mod/soundsbegone)**; Mute those annoying cows or chickens
- **[VTDownloader](https://modrinth.com/mod/vtdownloader)**; Allows you to download vanilla tweaks on the fly with whatever options you want
- **[Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap)**; See where you're going
- **[Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map)**; See where you've been

### Datapacks
There is one datapack included in this modpack and it, being a datapack, is completely optional for singleplayer survival, won't affect multiplayer experience and will not leave your world unable to update without it. The Datapack is called **[ Remove Anvil Prior Work Penalty](https://modrinth.com/datapack/no_anvil_penalty)**. This datapack makes it so that repairing items will always cost 1 experience level. This makes it so you can keep using tools without having to grind villagers for mending, which I personally hate more than anything in this game.

### Fun additions
Lastly, I added a few personal additions that you are free to remove if you wish. I added **[Cute Animal Models Backport](https://modrinth.com/mod/cute-animal-models-backport)** because I personally can't wait for the new baby mobs to be in the game and I added **[Do a Barrel Roll](https://modrinth.com/mod/do-a-barrel-roll)** because I prefer it over the usual elytra flight and I think everyone should give it a try! (You can toggle Do a Barrel Roll off through the menu when you press **V**)
